activity.role: Prefect of the Breton March and rearguard commander
activity.notes: This record is the historical Hruodland/Roland attested in connection with Charlemagne's 778 campaign, not the superhuman hero of the later Song of Roland. The directly attributable 778 Roncevaux episode is used as a representative historical point.
